description: Find the cheapest way to send money abroad. Compare fees, exchange rates and what your recipient gets, all in one place.

interface.longDescription:
Need to send money abroad? MoneyTransfers.com helps you find the cheapest ways to do it in seconds.

We compare money transfer apps and companies in one prompt, so you can see who gives your loved ones the most before you send anything.

All the comparisons are powered by the MoneyTransfers.com comparison engine, showing you the exchange rates, transfer fees and key features, always ranked from the cheapest.

We compare trusted companies like Wise, Revolut, Remitly, TapTap Send, Western Union, MoneyGram and dozens more.

And it works for any transfer, whether you’re supporting family abroad, paying a bill overseas, sending large amounts, or moving your own money between countries.

The app only compares, so you make the transfer yourself with the provider you choose. We may earn a commission when you visit a provider, but it never changes the order you see.

Try it with your next transfer, for example, send 1,000 GBP from the UK to India.
defaultPrompt: Send 1000 GBP from the UK to the United States in USD.
Send 3245 EUR from France to the Dominican Republic in DOP.
How much would my family in India get if I send 500 USD from the US?

positive.description: Compare providers for a specific route
positive.prompt: Send 1000 GBP from the UK to the United States in USD.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with amount 1000, countryFrom GB, countryTo US, currencyFrom GBP, currencyTo USD. Shows provider cards ranked by receive amount, each with the estimated fee, exchange rate and receive amount, a "Go to <provider>" button and a "View <provider> details" link. Above the cards, "Open in MoneyTransfers.com" opens the same comparison on the site. Below them are the mid-market rate and an "Affiliate disclaimer" link.

positive.description: EUR send with no specific country (EU lookup disclosed)
positive.prompt: Send 3245 EUR from EU to the Dominican Republic in DOP.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with amount 3245, countryFrom EU, countryTo DO, currencyFrom EUR, currencyTo DOP. Shows ranked provider cards and states that the lookup uses Spain (ES) as the default EUR country, asking for an exact country for more accurate results.

positive.description: EUR send from an exact EU country
positive.prompt: Send 3245 EUR from France to the Dominican Republic in DOP.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with amount 3245, countryFrom FR, countryTo DO, currencyFrom EUR, currencyTo DOP. Shows ranked provider cards with no default-country note.

positive.prompt: How much would my family in India get if I send 500 USD from the US?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with amount 500, countryFrom US, countryTo IN, currencyFrom USD, currencyTo INR. Shows provider cards ranked by the INR amount received, with fees and exchange rates.

positive.description: Asked to send money, it compares and explains it cannot send
positive.prompt: Send 500 GBP from the UK to the United States in USD using the cheapest provider.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with amount 500, countryFrom GB, countryTo US, currencyFrom GBP, currencyTo USD. Shows ranked provider cards and explains that the app only compares providers and cannot initiate, execute or process the transfer.

negative.description: Provider account support is out of scope
negative.prompt: Help me reset my Wise account password.

negative.description: Investment or savings advice is out of scope
negative.prompt: Should I keep my savings in GBP or move them into USD this year?

negative.description: Domestic banking is out of scope
negative.prompt: What is the best UK current account for everyday spending?

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell products, take payments or process transfers. Provider links go through MoneyTransfers.com, which may earn a referral commission when a user visits a provider.

publication.release_notes:
Initial release of the MoneyTransfers.com app.

- Compare money transfer providers by send amount, origin country or region, destination country and currency pair.
- Provider cards ranked by the amount the recipient receives, with estimated fees, exchange rates, receive amounts and ratings.
- "Go to <provider>" buttons open the provider's website through MoneyTransfers.com. An "Affiliate disclaimer" link explains that MoneyTransfers.com may earn a commission. It does not change the ranking.
- Provider details open on MoneyTransfers.com review pages.
- "Open in MoneyTransfers.com" opens the same comparison on the site.
- The mid-market rate used for the comparison shows under the results.
- EUR searches with no specific country use Spain (ES) for the lookup and say so, with a prompt to give an exact country.
- Checks transfer amounts, country codes and currency codes, with clear messages when there are no results.
- Light and dark appearance.
- Read-only. The app never initiates transfers or processes payments.
